description: Only relay a report from a person who is at, or was just at, the resort. Never invent a report. The report goes live immediately and is labelled as relayed via an AI assistant.

observed_today.description: True if the person saw these conditions today; omit if unknown.

rating.description: Overall conditions rating as a whole number, 1 to 5.

resort.description: Resort name such as 'Zermatt', or numeric resort id such as 675 (from search_resorts)

tags.description: Up to 6 condition tags from: powder, packed, icy, spring, slush, wind-hold, bluebird, groomed, heavy, crowded, quiet, closed.

text.description: The person's own note about conditions, up to 280 characters. Never invent one.
